name: Peanut Butter Banana Oatmeal
description: Creamy stovetop oats cooked in milk, topped with sliced banana and a spoonful of peanut butter.
steps: Bring the milk, 1 cup of water and the salt to a simmer in a small pot.
Stir in the oats and cinnamon and cook 5 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Divide between two bowls.
Top with sliced banana and a spoonful of peanut butter.

name: Apple Cinnamon Overnight Oats
description: Oats soaked overnight with milk, yogurt, diced apple and cinnamon for four grab-and-go breakfasts.
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, maple syrup, cinnamon and salt together in a bowl.
Fold in most of the diced apple.
Divide among four jars or containers and top with the remaining apple.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, or up to 4 days.
Eat cold, or microwave 1 minute to warm through.

name: Berry Yogurt Granola Parfaits
description: Thick Greek yogurt layered with mixed berries, crunchy granola, almonds and a drizzle of honey.
steps: Thaw the berries in the microwave for 1 minute, or overnight in the fridge.
Spoon half of the yogurt into two glasses or bowls.
Layer on half of the berries and granola, then repeat with the rest.
Top with the almonds and drizzle with honey.

name: Berry Banana Yogurt Smoothies
description: Frozen berries and banana blended with yogurt and milk into a thick, filling smoothie.
steps: Add the milk and yogurt to a blender first.
Add the bananas, frozen berries and honey.
Blend on high for 1 minute until completely smooth.
Pour into two glasses and serve right away.

name: Fluffy Pancakes with Maple Syrup
description: Tall from-scratch pancakes made with pantry staples; extras freeze well for toaster mornings.
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt together in a large bowl.
Melt the butter. Whisk the milk, egg and 2 tablespoons of the melted butter together.
Stir the wet mixture into the dry until just combined; a few lumps are fine.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and brush it with some of the remaining butter.
Pour in 1/4 cup of batter per pancake and cook 2 minutes, until bubbles pop on top.
Flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more, until golden.
Serve stacked with maple syrup.

name: Avocado Toast with Fried Eggs
description: Toasted whole wheat bread piled with lemony mashed avocado and a fried egg on each slice.
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocados with the lemon juice and salt.
Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat and fry the eggs 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Spread the avocado on the toast and top each slice with an egg.
Finish with black pepper and red pepper flakes.

name: Strawberry Cottage Cheese Granola Bowls
description: Protein-packed cottage cheese topped with sliced strawberries, crunchy granola and a drizzle of honey.
steps: Hull and slice the strawberries.
Divide the cottage cheese between two bowls.
Top with the strawberries and granola and drizzle with the honey.

name: Mushroom Spinach Cheddar Omelets
description: Three-egg omelets folded around sauteed mushrooms, wilted spinach and melted cheddar.
steps: Melt half of the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and cook the mushrooms 4 minutes, until browned.
Add the spinach and stir until wilted, then move the vegetables to a plate.
Beat the eggs with the salt and pepper.
Melt half of the remaining butter over medium heat, pour in half of the eggs and cook 2 minutes, lifting the edges, until just set.
Fill with half of the vegetables and cheddar, fold over and slide onto a plate.
Repeat for the second omelet.

name: Crustless Spinach Feta Quiche
description: An easy no-crust quiche with spinach, feta and mozzarella that slices and reheats well all week.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and butter a 9-inch pie dish.
Thaw the spinach and squeeze it very dry in a clean towel.
Whisk the eggs, cream, salt and pepper together in a large bowl.
Stir in the spinach, diced onion, feta and mozzarella.
Pour into the dish and bake 30 to 35 minutes, until set in the center and golden.
Cool 5 minutes, then cut into wedges.

name: Potato Pepper Breakfast Hash with Eggs
description: Crispy skillet potatoes with bell pepper and onion, finished with eggs cooked right in the pan.
steps: Dice the potatoes into 1/2-inch cubes; dice the pepper and onion.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the potatoes 12 minutes, stirring now and then, until golden.
Add the pepper, onion, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper and cook 5 minutes.
Make four wells in the hash and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook over medium-low heat 4 to 5 minutes, until the whites are set.

name: Sausage Egg and Cheese Breakfast Burritos
description: Freezer-friendly burritos stuffed with sausage, hash browns, scrambled eggs, cheddar and salsa.
steps: Brown the sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat 5 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the hash browns and cook 5 minutes, until crisp at the edges.
Beat the eggs, pour them in and stir 2 minutes, until just set.
Warm the tortillas and divide the filling, cheddar and salsa among them.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Eat now, or wrap in foil and freeze; reheat unwrapped in the microwave 2 minutes.

name: Ham and Cheddar Egg Muffin Cups
description: Baked egg cups with ham, cheddar and bell pepper: twelve from one muffin tin for the week.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin with the butter.
Dice the ham and bell pepper and slice the green onions; divide among the cups with the cheddar.
Beat the eggs with the salt and pepper and pour evenly into the cups.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes, until puffed and set.
Cool 5 minutes and lift out. Refrigerate up to 4 days and reheat 30 seconds in the microwave.

name: Bacon, Eggs and Avocado Plates
description: A classic low-carb plate of crisp bacon, eggs fried in butter and sliced avocado.
steps: Lay the bacon in a cold skillet and cook over medium heat 8 minutes, turning, until crisp; drain on paper towels.
Pour off most of the fat, add the butter and fry the eggs 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Slice the avocado.
Plate the eggs with the bacon and avocado and season with salt and pepper.

name: Cinnamon French Toast
description: Bread soaked in cinnamon-vanilla custard, griddled golden in butter and served with maple syrup.
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, cinnamon and vanilla together in a shallow dish.
Melt half of the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Dip four slices of bread in the custard, letting each side soak a few seconds.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden brown.
Repeat with the remaining butter and bread.
Serve with maple syrup.

name: Sausage and Pepper Egg Scramble
description: Breakfast sausage and bell pepper scrambled with eggs and finished with melted cheddar.
steps: Brown the sausage in a skillet over medium-high heat 5 minutes, breaking it into crumbles.
Add the diced bell pepper and cook 3 minutes, until softened.
Beat the eggs with the salt and pepper, pour them in and stir gently 2 minutes, until just set.
Sprinkle with the cheddar, cover 1 minute to melt and serve.

name: Classic Tuna Salad Sandwiches
description: Creamy tuna salad with crunchy celery and lemon on whole wheat bread with crisp lettuce.
steps: Drain the tuna well and flake it into a bowl.
Stir in the mayonnaise, finely diced celery, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Pile onto two slices of bread and top with lettuce leaves.
Close the sandwiches and cut in half.

name: Deli-Style Egg Salad Sandwiches
description: Chopped hard-boiled eggs in a creamy mustard dressing with celery, on whole wheat bread.
steps: Cover the eggs with water in a pot, bring to a boil, then cover, turn off the heat and let stand 11 minutes.
Cool the eggs under cold water, peel and chop.
Mix with the mayonnaise, mustard, diced celery, sliced green onions, paprika, salt and pepper.
Spread onto four slices of bread, add lettuce and top with the remaining bread.

name: Rotisserie Chicken Salad Lettuce Cups
description: Shredded rotisserie chicken in a creamy lemon-mustard dressing, scooped into crisp romaine leaves.
steps: Pull the meat from the chicken, discard the skin and bones, and chop or shred it.
Stir the mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice, salt and pepper together in a large bowl.
Fold in the chicken, diced celery and sliced green onions.
Separate the romaine leaves and spoon the chicken salad into them.
Keep leftover chicken salad in the fridge up to 4 days and fill the leaves just before eating.

name: Black Bean and Corn Quesadillas
description: Crispy folded tortillas filled with melted cheddar, black beans and corn, with salsa for dipping.
steps: Drain and rinse the beans, then mix them with the corn and cumin.
Cover half of each tortilla with cheddar and the bean mixture, then fold over.
Heat a little of the oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook the quesadillas two at a time, 2 to 3 minutes per side, until crisp and melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with the salsa.

name: Meal-Prep Chicken Burrito Bowls
description: Taco-seasoned chicken thighs over rice with black beans, corn, salsa and cheddar, packed for four lunches.
steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and toss with the taco seasoning.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken 8 minutes, until browned and cooked through.
Warm the drained beans and the corn together in the microwave 2 minutes.
Divide the rice among four containers and top with the chicken, beans, corn, salsa and cheddar.
Squeeze lime over the top. Refrigerate up to 4 days.

name: Greek Chickpea Salad
description: Chickpeas tossed with cucumber, tomato, red onion and feta in a lemon-oregano dressing.
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Dice the cucumber and tomatoes and thinly slice the red onion.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt and pepper together in a large bowl.
Add the chickpeas, vegetables and feta and toss well.
Serve now, or refrigerate up to 4 days.

name: Lemony Lentil Vegetable Soup
description: A thick lentil soup with carrots, celery and tomatoes, brightened with lemon; reheats well all week.
steps: Dice the onion, carrots and celery and mince the garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the vegetables 6 minutes, until softened.
Stir in the garlic and cumin for 30 seconds.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, broth, 2 cups of water, salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
Simmer partly covered 25 minutes, until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the lemon juice and serve.

name: Turkey and Cheddar Lettuce Roll-Ups
description: No-cook, no-bread roll-ups of deli turkey and cheese in romaine leaves, with cucumber sticks.
steps: Separate the romaine into eight large leaves.
Stir the mayonnaise and mustard together and spread a little down each leaf.
Layer on the turkey and half a slice of cheese, then roll up tightly.
Cut the cucumber into sticks and pack alongside.

name: Tuna Egg Salad Stuffed Avocados
description: Avocado halves filled with a lemony tuna and hard-boiled egg salad.
steps: Cover the eggs with water in a small pot, bring to a boil, then cover, turn off the heat and let stand 11 minutes.
Cool the eggs under cold water, peel and chop.
Drain the tuna and mix with the eggs, mayonnaise, diced celery, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Halve and pit the avocados.
Spoon the salad into and over the avocado halves.

name: Ground Turkey Egg Roll Bowls
description: All the flavor of an egg roll without the wrapper: turkey and cabbage stir-fried with ginger, garlic and soy.
steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the turkey 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Stir in the minced garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the coleslaw mix and soy sauce and cook 4 minutes, tossing, until the cabbage is tender-crisp.
Stir in the sesame oil and most of the sliced green onions.
Divide among four containers, top with the remaining green onions and a drizzle of sriracha.

name: Creamy Broccoli Cheddar Soup
description: A thick, cheesy broccoli soup made with frozen florets and no flour; reheats well for lunches.
steps: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat and cook the diced onion 4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic for 30 seconds, then the broth and broccoli.
Bring to a boil and simmer 8 minutes, until the broccoli is very tender.
Mash with a potato masher, or blend briefly, leaving some texture.
Stir in the cream, then the cheddar a handful at a time over low heat until melted.
Season with the salt and pepper.

name: Hummus Veggie Pita Pockets
description: Warm pita halves spread with hummus and stuffed with spinach, cucumber, tomato, carrot and feta.
steps: Cut the pitas in half and open the pockets.
Spread hummus inside each half.
Slice the cucumber and tomato and shred the carrot.
Stuff the pockets with the spinach, vegetables and feta.

name: Grilled Cheese with Tomato Soup
description: Buttery griddled cheese sandwiches with a quick creamy tomato soup for dunking.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the diced onion 4 minutes; add the minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the crushed tomatoes, broth, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper and simmer 10 minutes.
Blend the soup until smooth and stir in the cream.
Butter one side of each bread slice and sandwich two slices of cheese between each pair, butter side out.
Cook the sandwiches in a skillet over medium-low heat 3 minutes per side, until golden and melted.
Cut in half and serve with the soup.

name: Italian Veggie Pasta Salad
description: Penne tossed with tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper and mozzarella in a tangy Italian vinaigrette.
steps: Cook the penne in salted boiling water according to the package directions.
Drain and rinse under cold water until cool.
Whisk the olive oil, vinegar, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt and pepper together in a large bowl.
Halve the tomatoes, dice the cucumber and bell pepper and thinly slice the red onion.
Toss the pasta, vegetables, mozzarella and parmesan with the dressing.
Serve now, or refrigerate up to 4 days.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad, No Croutons
description: Seared sliced chicken over crisp romaine with parmesan and a quick creamy Caesar dressing.
steps: Season the chicken with the garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken 6 minutes per side, until cooked through; rest 5 minutes and slice.
Whisk the mayonnaise, lemon juice, grated garlic, mustard, Worcestershire and half of the parmesan into a dressing.
Chop the romaine and toss it with the dressing.
Top with the chicken and the remaining parmesan.
To pack ahead, keep the dressing separate.
